description: Next.js React frontend with modern UI framework, authentication flow, main dashboard, sidebar navigation, and complete UI for Cadastros and Matriculas CRUD modules. This implements the modernized visual interface while preserving 100% of the operational logic from the legacy system. Design references: Salesforce, Hubspot, Notion, Monday, Linear, Stripe Dashboard style.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/frontend/ as a Next.js application with App Router, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui component library
Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/frontend/app/layout.tsx with root layout including dark/light mode support via next-themes, global styles, and font configuration
Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/frontend/components/ui/ with base UI components: Button, Input, Select, Table, Card, Dialog, Form, Badge, Tabs, Dropdown, Toast/Notification

Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/frontend/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx - Modern collapsible sidebar with all menu items matching the legacy system: Cadastro, Movimentacao, Pesquisa, Relatorio, Utilitario, Ajuda, Janela, Estagio, Financeiro. Each with their respective submenus
Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/frontend/components/layout/Header.tsx - Top header with global search, user profile, notifications, and theme toggle
Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/frontend/components/layout/DashboardLayout.tsx - Main layout wrapper combining sidebar, header, and content area
Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/frontend/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx - Login page with email/password form, JWT token handling, and redirect logic
Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/frontend/lib/auth.ts - Authentication utilities: token storage, refresh logic, protected route HOC/middleware
Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/frontend/lib/api.ts - API client with axios/fetch wrapper, automatic token refresh, error handling
Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/frontend/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx - Executive dashboard with KPI cards, charts placeholders, recent activity feed, quick actions

Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/frontend/app/(dashboard)/cadastros/ directory with pages for all basic registration entities: cursos (courses), turmas (classes), disciplinas (disciplines), professores (teachers), alunos (students) - each with list view (data table with search/filter/pagination), create form, edit form, detail view

Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/frontend/app/(dashboard)/matriculas/ directory with pages for enrollment management: list view, new enrollment form, enrollment details with action buttons (renew, transfer, cancel, suspend), enrollment history
Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/frontend/components/shared/DataTable.tsx - Reusable data table component with sorting, filtering, pagination, row selection, and bulk actions
Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/frontend/components/shared/FormBuilder.tsx - Reusable form component with validation (using react-hook-form + zod)
Create /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app/src/frontend/hooks/ with custom hooks: useAuth, useApi, useToast, useDebounce, usePagination
Add frontend build configuration and ensure the complete frontend builds without errors
acceptance_criteria: Running 'npm run build' in the app directory successfully compiles both backend and frontend
The frontend has a working login page that communicates with the backend auth API
The sidebar navigation contains all menu items from the legacy system (Cadastro, Movimentacao, Pesquisa, Relatorio, Utilitario, Ajuda, Janela, Estagio, Financeiro)
The dashboard page renders with KPI card placeholders and layout structure
The Cadastros module has complete CRUD UI for at least 3 entities (courses, classes, students) with list/create/edit/detail views
The Matriculas module has enrollment list, creation form, and detail view with action buttons
Dark mode and light mode toggle works correctly
The DataTable component supports sorting, filtering, and pagination
Forms use validation with appropriate error messages
verification: Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app && npm run build' and confirm zero compilation errors for both backend and frontend
Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/app && npm test' and confirm all tests pass
Verify that the Next.js pages compile without TypeScript errors by checking build output
